reviewItem.question: For "Allow crossplane to merge existing MRDs from provider MRDs by @n3wscott in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6685", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: whether the cluster contains existing MRDs that overlap with MRDs supplied by the installed provider packages

proposed.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 now allows Crossplane to merge existing MRDs from provider MRDs.
